items.title: Revoy hybrid tandem trailer rolls towards reality with $27 million raise
items.summary: By packing batteries and an electric drive axle into a tandem trailer that fits between a conventional semi truck and trailer, Revoy EV promises to “electrify” trucking and cut a fleet’s fuel bill in half. Now, after years of development, the concept is taking some real steps towards production. In fact, it’s taking 27 million of them!
items.translatedTitle: REVOY HYBRID TANDEM TRAILER以2700万$的融资走向现实

items.title: Distributed solar supplied 27% of Pakistan’s electricity in 2025
items.summary:
Analysis by the Pakistan Solar Association finds roughly 51 TWh of generation that never appears on grid-side data, as rooftop and off-grid solar spreads faster than official statistics. The association claims unseen generation can be inferred from a deepening midday demand trough, with network design suffering as a result.
The post Distributed solar supplied 27% of Pakistan’s electricity in 2025 appeared first on pv magazine Global.

items.title: Researchers design PVT heat pump with single integrated evaporator
